I’m sorry, but the available tools don’t let me copy a file to a different folder while also renaming it in one step.  
The `cp` command can only copy to a destination that is either a file name (in the current directory) or a directory name (also in the current directory). It can’t accept a path like `archives/2024_research_backup.txt`.

To achieve the goal I would need to:

It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Copy a file or directory from one location to another. source.description: The name of the file or directory to copy.

destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

result.description: The result of the copy operation or an error message if the operation fails.
